baseline_schema_alignment: PASS: saved predictions, targets, metrics and trusted models agree

comparison_metrics.target_definition: 1: a qualifying Steam-store discount was recorded during the official Autumn Sale window; 0: no qualifying discount was recorded. Zero does not establish absence of an actual discount. Probabilities concern recorded occurrence, not verified participation.

coverage_diagnostic.analysis: Post-hoc exploratory coverage sensitivity motivated by Phase 7A; not a primary/production model.
coverage_diagnostic.distinction: No discount-specific counts, recencies or indicators enter this diagnostic; they mix discount behavior and observation availability.
coverage_diagnostic.interpretation: Strong coverage-only results would suggest the operational target partly reflects provider observation patterns; they cannot establish the precise source of the signal.

execution_checks.determinism_note: PNG/model bytes compared in this environment; cross-platform identity is not guaranteed.

scope: Phase 7B only; no Phase 8/9, population expansion or 2026 predictions.

secondary_temporal_results.limitations: Different training sizes and evaluation years; not a controlled temporal-drift estimate. Games recur in training. 2024 outcomes contribute to primary training, so this check is not an independent confirmatory test.
